name: workspace
// targets: Workspace-wide tasks that don't belong to a single project.

format-check.// cache: Disabled: in Nx's file map the root project only owns files outside apps/libs, so a cached whole-repo check would go stale when project files change.

mail-previews.// description: Renders docs/mail/ from config/. Pass --config-dir/--out to proof-read another deployment's wording without touching docs/.

order-lifecycle.// description: Rebuilds the generated tables, diagram and journeys in docs/order-lifecycle.md.
